acceptance_criteria: Limit keys for redeem and code-gated signup recorded; p2-redeem, p3-adult-auth and p9-ratelimit agree
description:
REVIEW finding 20 and ARCHITECTURE section 9 say login and redeem are limited per account. p2-redeem says 'Rate limit per account and per IP (IP held in memory only)' and locks the account after ten failures an hour. Signup also takes a kit code (p3-adult-auth), but before signup there is no account to limit, so per-account limits cannot protect signup-time code guessing. A per-IP limit is what REVIEW finding 20 warns about for a classroom on one public IP, though adults redeem codes far less often than students join.

Needed: the limit key(s) for redeem and for signup with a code (per IP in memory, global, per code prefix, CAPTCHA-free backoff, ...).

Filed during beads setup (prompt 01, step 8).
title: DECISION: rate-limit keys for code redemption and code-gated signup
